title: CycloneDX Pre-Defined Perspectives Registry
description: Registry of well-known, pre-defined perspectives. Maps each reserved perspective identity (cdx:perspectives: namespace) to the catalog document that defines it under the repository's perspectives/ directory. This registry is maintained independently of the CycloneDX specification release cycle: perspectives may be added or revised here, and new catalog document versions published, without a change to the versioned specification schemas. The specification schema references only preDefinedPerspectivesEnum; the identity-to-document mapping is in catalog.

preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Identities
preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.description: The reserved identities of well-known, pre-defined perspectives, using the reserved cdx:perspectives: namespace path. Referenced by the specification's perspective schema.

catalog.$comment: Registry data, expressed with schema keywords so this file remains a single valid JSON Schema. For each identity, `const` is the catalog document path (relative to the repository root) and `description` documents the perspective. Tooling resolves a reference by reading properties.<id>.const.
catalog.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Catalog
catalog.description: Maps each pre-defined perspective identity to its catalog document.

cdx:perspectives:model-card.description: A transparency view for machine learning models following the industry-standard model card structure, covering model details, intended use, training data and procedure, quantitative analysis, technical limitations, and ethical and environmental considerations.

cdx:perspectives:pqc-readiness.description: A view for assessing readiness for the post-quantum cryptography migration, covering cryptographic inventory, quantum resistance of the cryptography in use, and cryptographic agility. Catalog document contributed separately (CycloneDX/specification#960).
